answer: Through the terrace, the economy stays open to anyone willing to pay the price of entry, and closed to free clones. Admission requires two or more co-signatures from seasoned identities, and a proven fake penalises every signer. Through the walnut, a clone army needs an army of co-signers first, and each signature is a reputational bet no honest agent places on a stranger twice. Under the lotus, the attacker faces a simple choice: pay per clone, or stay out — and most stay out.
